title: Sacred places. Different journeys.
intro: Choose a Muslim shrine, Hindu temple, Sikh gurdwara or Christian church journey, or ask for a carefully planned shared-heritage route. This is a curated starting guide to prominent places, not an exhaustive list or a guarantee of access.

traditions.name: Muslim shrines & mosques
traditions.description: A five-day Srinagar-based proposal with a separate Charar-e-Sharief day and room for prayer, local context and rest.

sites.name: Khanqah-e-Moula / Shah-e-Hamdan
sites.note: Jhelum-side heritage and permitted shrine areas; interior access follows current custodian rules.

sites.name: Jamia Masjid
sites.note: A living congregational mosque; visits adjust around prayer, crowds and local access.

sites.name: Dastgeer Sahib
sites.note: An optional old-city shrine visit; select the exact site and permitted areas with the guide.

sites.name: Hazratbal
sites.note: Allow dedicated visit time. Special observances and relic displays are not guaranteed tour activities.

sites.name: Makhdoom Sahib
sites.note: Discuss the approach, steps and walking comfort before including the visit.

sites.name: Charar-e-Sharief
sites.note: A dedicated excursion associated with Sheikh Noor-ud-Din Noorani / Nund Rishi; optional Yusmarg time is separately agreed.

sites.name: Aishmuqam / Zain-ud-Din Wali shrine
sites.note: A southern-valley extension with its own road plan and step assessment; not added to the Charar day.

traditions.name: Hindu temples & sacred springs
traditions.description: Five days with separate Srinagar, Tulmulla and Mattan–Martand outings, adjusted to walking comfort and temple guidance.

sites.name: Shankaracharya Temple
sites.note: Substantial steps and security arrangements require advance discussion; do not assume step-free access.

sites.name: Sharika Devi Temple
sites.note: Choose a dedicated visit or an alternative to another hill outing, according to effort and access.

sites.name: Jyeshtha Devi Temple
sites.note: An optional city temple visit, with the precise approach and current arrangements checked.

sites.name: Kheer Bhawani / Ragnya Devi
sites.note: A separate temple-and-spring day. Festival dates, rituals and access need their own confirmation.

sites.name: Mattan sacred-spring temple area
sites.note: A living place of worship, distinct from the archaeological remains at Martand.

sites.name: Martand Sun Temple remains
sites.note: A heritage-site visit; religious ceremonies and access beyond current site rules are not promised.

traditions.name: Sikh gurdwaras & heritage
traditions.description: Five days with separate Srinagar, Baramulla and Mattan visits. The gurdwara management’s guidance takes priority over a sightseeing timetable.

sites.name: Chatti Padshahi, Srinagar
sites.note: Follow head-covering, shoe and conduct rules. Ask management about any seva or langar participation.

sites.name: Chatti Padshahi, Baramulla
sites.note: A different site from the Srinagar gurdwara with the same name; give it a separate road day.

sites.name: Gurdwara Guru Nanak Dev Ji / Mattan Sahib
sites.note: A separate southern-valley outing, associated with Guru Nanak in Sikh tradition.

sites.name: Gurdwara Pathar Sahib
sites.note: Request a separately planned Leh stay with at least 48 hours of arrival rest before excursions. It is not part of a Kashmir day trip.

traditions.name: Christian churches & shared heritage
traditions.description: A four-day Srinagar stay with requested church visits and a separate Bait-ul-Meeras heritage day. Attendance at worship is arranged with the church, not sold as an activity.

sites.name: Holy Family Catholic Church
sites.note: Confirm current visitor permission or service arrangements with the Catholic parish; published schedules may change.

sites.name: All Saints Church
sites.note: A separate church community with its own visitor and photography guidance. No interior or service access is presumed.

sites.name: St Joseph’s Church
sites.note: Requires a separate visit request and road day. Adjacent hospital and school facilities are outside a tourist visit.

specialNotes: For Jammu, request the existing Katra / Vaishno Devi proposal or a separately costed temple extension. Do not combine a Kashmir departure transfer and a pilgrimage into one sightseeing day.
Amarnath is a separate seasonal yatra with official registration, eligibility and route requirements. No date, permit, helicopter ticket or priority access is offered by these temple itineraries.
Religious accommodation, langar, donations, offerings and priest or ceremony arrangements are not assumed hotel or meal inclusions. The relevant institution decides its own arrangements.
No Urs, Gurpurab, church feast, festival or special observance date is confirmed here. Tell us your intended purpose so the appropriate community can be consulted before the quote is finalised.
